mapper.sql: a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= CAST(#{to} AS date) AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= CAST(#{from} AS date)
mapper.select: SELECT d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",d.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber",d.DEV_NM AS "name",d.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,'–') AS "jobName",d.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",d.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", d.WORK_STAT_CD AS "workStatusCode",d.JNCMP_DT AS "hireDate",d.RETIRE_DT AS "retirementDate", e.first_end AS "firstAssignmentEndDate",e.last_end AS "lastAssignmentEndDate" FROM TB_HR_DEV d LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=d.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.DEV_ID,MIN(a.INPUT_END_DT) AS first_end,MAX(a.INPUT_END_DT) AS last_end FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' GROUP BY a.DEV_ID) e ON e.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID WHERE ORDER BY d.DEV_NM,d.DEV_ID

SELECT a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "projectStatus",a.INPUT_BGN_DT AS "startDate",a.INPUT_END_DT AS "endDate", a.CTRT_MM AS "contractMm",a.EXT_PSBL_CD AS "extensionCode",e.CODE_NM AS "extensionName" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE e ON e.CODE_GRP_ID='EXT_PSBL' AND e.CODE=a.EXT_PSBL_CD WHERE AND
ORDER BY a.INPUT_END_DT,a.ASGN_ID

SELECT m.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",m.INPUT_YM AS "month",m.MON_MM AS "monthlyMm" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID WHERE AND AND m.INPUT_YM BETWEEN to_char(CAST(#{from} AS date),'YYYYMM') AND to_char(CAST(#{to} AS date),'YYYYMM') ORDER BY m.ASGN_ID,m.INPUT_YM

SELECT h.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",h.APLY_DT AS "appliedDate",h.HIST_SN::int AS "sequence", h.NEW_CTRT_MM AS "contractMm" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=h.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID WHERE AND AND h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD IN ('INPUT','RATE') AND h.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL AND h.APLY_DT <= CAST(#{to} AS date) ORDER BY h.ASGN_ID,h.APLY_DT,h.HIST_SN

SELECT s.DEV_ID AS "developerId",s.WORK_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", s.BGN_DT AS "startDate",s.END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=s.DEV_ID WHERE AND s.BGN_DT <= CAST(#{to} AS date) AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= CAST(#{from} AS date)) ORDER BY s.DEV_ID,s.STAT_SN

SELECT t.DEV_ID AS "developerId",o.OPP_NM AS "projectName", to_date(t.BGN_YM,'YYYYMM') AS "startDate", (to_date(n.BGN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => n.PRD_MCNT::int)-interval '1 day')::date AS "endDate", o.WIN_PRBL_RT AS "winningProbability" FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=t.DEV_ID JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=t.OPP_ID AND o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' JOIN TB_SL_OPP_NEED n ON n.OPP_ID=t.OPP_ID AND n.NEED_SN=t.NEED_SN WHERE t.TENT_STAT_CD='ACT' AND AND to_date(t.BGN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= CAST(#{to} AS date) ORDER BY t.BGN_YM,t.TENT_ID

SELECT c.CODE_GRP_ID AS "groupCode",c.CODE AS "code",c.CODE_NM AS "name" FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID IN ('JOB','GRADE','EMP_TYPE') AND c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY c.CODE_GRP_ID,c.SORT_ORD,c.CODE
